task.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone collectible occult pathway emblem, precision jewelry-grade relief artwork for a card asset library. Original artistic interpretation for the 母亲 / mother pathway, NOT a copied official religious emblem. Primary design: A lush protective seed-vessel crest, two broad ivory seed halves enclose a vivid green shoot and extensive intertwined roots forming a rounded shelter. Deep green enamel, ivory, warm earth-dark patina and subtle golden veins. Organic heart-seed silhouette, no human mother or generic flower bouquet. Craftsmanship: museum-quality micro-chased metal, layered pierced openwork, satin recesses contrasting polished bevels, restrained precious inlays; rich sculptural depth and genuinely exquisite detail, NOT a flat vector outline or generic app icon. One coherent primary symbol with a bold readable silhouette, not a pile of objects. Straight-on orthographic view, whole emblem centered occupying about 78% of a SQUARE canvas, generous clean margin. Soft upper-left studio illumination; no ground plane or cast shadow outside the object. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, including all internal openwork holes; no black rectangle, no white rectangle, no checkerboard pixels. No text, letters, digits, watermark, card border, human portrait or surrounding scene.
